Frontier validation is game grouped; the older metric artifact note must be read with its manifest.
Three 32-position cohorts have different candidate unions and difficulty; retain separate results.
Arena has only two opening pairs.
No new model or search default was promoted.
Oracle-WDL substitutes only WDL, keeps existing policy/Q, and is not a CP oracle.
